skill.name: geo-transform
skill.description: Proposes evidence-bounded content edits that improve readability and structure while preserving meaning, voice, provenance, and reviewability.
skill.summary: Restructure content without inventing facts, outcomes, or unsupported metadata.
skill.author: cucuwang

security_audit.summary: The skill is prompt-only and contains no executable code, network access, external commands, or secret handling. No static findings, semantic risks, or prompt-injection attempts were found.

content.value_statement: Content revisions can weaken meaning or introduce unsupported claims. This skill proposes focused, reviewable edits while preserving voice, provenance, and factual boundaries.
actual_capabilities: Reviews one authorized content file within an explicit scope.
Classifies findings as requirements, deterministic checks, heuristics, or experiments.
Proposes a focused diff before changing the source file.
Splits dense paragraphs and repairs confusing document outlines.
Identifies unsupported quantitative claims for citation or removal.
Compares deterministic scan results before and after an edit.
limitations: It does not guarantee ranking, indexing, rich results, traffic, or citations.
It cannot supply missing facts, sources, quotes, authors, dates, or benefits.
It does not batch-edit files without explicit authorization and scope.
It proposes structured data only when visible content and current documentation support it.

use_cases.title: Clarify Editorial Drafts
use_cases.description: Improve paragraph flow and reduce repetition while preserving the writer's original meaning and voice.

use_cases.title: Review Evidence Claims
use_cases.description: Find unsupported quantitative statements and recommend citation or removal without creating replacement evidence.

use_cases.title: Restructure Web Content
use_cases.description: Repair confusing headings and assess structured data proposals against visible content and current documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Paragraph Clarity
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this authorized paragraph for readability. Propose a focused revision that preserves meaning, facts, provenance, and voice.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a dense paragraph

prompt_templates.title: Repair a Document Outline
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this authorized document outline. Identify genuine comprehension problems and propose the smallest structural changes needed.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Quantitative Claims
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this authorized content for quantitative claims. Separate supported claims from unsupported claims, then recommend citation or removal.

prompt_templates.title: Run an Evidence-Bounded Transformation
prompt_templates.prompt: Classify the supplied scan findings, propose a focused diff, apply only approved edits, rerun the scan, and report reproducible changes separately.

output_examples.input: A long paragraph repeats the same supported point three times.
output_examples.output: Proposed edit: combine the repeated statements into one concise paragraph while retaining the cited evidence and original conclusion.

output_examples.input: A page says conversions increased by 40 percent but provides no source.
output_examples.output: Finding: the quantitative claim lacks provenance. Add a reliable citation or remove the percentage; do not replace it with an estimate.

output_examples.input: A document uses several top-level headings that still form a clear outline.
output_examples.output: No structural edit proposed. Multiple top-level headings are not automatically wrong, and the current outline remains understandable.

best_practices: Authorize one file and define the editing scope before analysis.
Review the proposed diff before approving any source change.
Compare the same deterministic scan before and after editing.
anti_patterns: Do not invent evidence, benefits, sources, or performance outcomes.
Do not treat a higher scan score as proof of external results.
Do not generate structured data that exceeds visible page content.

faq.question: What content does this skill edit?
faq.answer: It reviews one authorized file and proposes focused readability, structure, provenance, or documented technical improvements.

faq.question: Will it preserve the original voice?
faq.answer: Yes. Its workflow requires preserving meaning and voice while reducing confusion or repetition.

faq.question: Can it create facts or citations?
faq.answer: No. It identifies unsupported material but does not invent facts, sources, quotes, dates, or authors.

faq.question: Does it guarantee search ranking improvements?
faq.answer: No. Scan changes are reported separately from ranking, indexing, rich results, traffic, or citation outcomes.

faq.question: Can it edit many files at once?
faq.answer: Only when the user provides explicit batch scope. The default workflow covers one authorized file.

faq.question: When does it propose structured data?
faq.answer: Only when the markup matches visible content and current documentation. It does not automatically generate FAQ schema.
